beats.beat: The company's product range falls into four categories: Functional Additives (FA), Chemically Modified Minerals (CMM), Soft Minerals (SM), and Hard Minerals (HM). These are specialty chemicals used to improve properties like durability, texture, and colour in end products.
The company has a long-term arrangement with its corporate promoter, 20 Microns Limited, which markets and sells the company's products through its network.
Customer concentration is moderate: the top 10 customers accounted for about 59% of revenue from operations in each of FY2015, FY2016, and FY2017.
Exports go to Nigeria, Saudi Arabia, and Sri Lanka, with cumulative exports of ₹1,068.18 lakh over five years.

The company lists its competitive strengths as a diversified product portfolio, diversified user industries, import substitution, support from its holding company, product innovation and continuous R&D, and a strong management team.

Cash flow from operations has been volatile: ₹200.97 lakh (FY2013), ₹127.73 lakh (FY2014), ₹422.36 lakh (FY2015), ₹802.59 lakh (FY2016), ₹(349.75) lakh (FY2017), and ₹124.86 lakh (six months ended September 2017).
Total assets stood at ₹3,018.66 lakh (FY2013), ₹2,679.38 lakh (FY2014), ₹2,592.53 lakh (FY2015), ₹2,767.21 lakh (FY2016), ₹3,273.96 lakh (FY2017), and ₹3,424.96 lakh (September 2017).
Basic earnings per share (EPS) was ₹(0.45), ₹(0.20), ₹2.47, ₹1.46, ₹2.43, and ₹1.48 for the same periods respectively.

beats.beat: The promoters are Mr. Chandresh S. Parikh, Mr. Atil C. Parikh, Mr. Rajesh C. Parikh, and 20 Microns Limited (the corporate promoter).
Promoters hold 89,48,270 equity shares, representing 99.76% of the pre-issue paid-up equity share capital. The promoter group (excluding promoters) holds 21,510 shares, or 0.24%.
The company has entered into related party transactions in the past and may continue to do so, as detailed in the financial statements.

Governance flags include instances of non-filing or delayed filings with the Registrar of Companies (RoC), and the company has not obtained all statutory licences for one of its manufacturing facilities (Plot 9-10, GIDC Waghodia).

beats.beat: The Indian specialty chemicals (excluding agrochemicals and dyestuff) market was estimated at approximately ₹1,000 billion in FY2017, according to CRISIL Research cited in the DRHP.
The segment grew at a CAGR of 10-12% from FY2014 to FY2017 and is forecast to grow at 12-14% CAGR over the next few years.

Key demand drivers include increased consumption intensity, rising middle-class households (projected 148 million by 2030), and government initiatives such as the Draft National Chemical Policy and 100% FDI in the sector.

The industry is highly fragmented, with small and medium enterprises holding 70-75% market share. Global players also compete, but only a few Indian players have the scale to match them in product development.

Headwinds acknowledged in the filing include higher imports relative to exports (import CAGR 6.4% vs export CAGR 6% over 2012-13 to 2016-17), strict REACH regulations for exports to Europe, and the transition to GST from July 2017.

beats.beat: 20 Microns Nano Minerals Limited processes and sells specialty chemicals — functional additives and chemically modified minerals — used across industries like paints, plastics, and cosmetics. It is part of the larger 20 Microns group, which also acts as its marketing channel.
The company is now raising capital through an IPO to fund a new manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, and to list its shares on NSE EMERGE, the SME platform.
The offer is being managed by Vivro Financial Services Private Limited and the registrar is Link Intime India Private Limited.

intro.purpose: Orient the reader: 20 Microns Nano Minerals is a specialty chemicals processor and seller, part of the 20 Microns group, raising funds for a new plant and listing on NSE EMERGE.

beats.beat: The lead manager to the issue is Vivro Financial Services Private Limited. Link Intime India Private Limited is the registrar.

The objects of the issue are: (1) funding capital expenditure for a new manufacturing facility at Plot 336, GIDC Waghodia, Vadodara, Gujarat; (2) general corporate purposes; and (3) creating a public trading market for the equity shares by listing on NSE EMERGE to enhance visibility and brand.
The DRHP does not disclose whether the issue includes an offer for sale or the number of shares being offered. The price band is also not yet available.

beats.beat: 1. No long-term contracts: The company has not entered into long-term or definitive agreements with customers or raw material suppliers, relying instead on purchase orders. This creates vulnerability to volume and price fluctuations. [^drhp-p25] [^drhp-p26]
2. Negative cash flows: The company has reported negative cash flows from operations in FY2017 (₹349.75 lakh outflow). Sustained negative cash flows could strain liquidity. [^drhp-p22]

3. Regulatory non-compliance: The company has not obtained certain statutory licences for its manufacturing facility at Plot 9-10, GIDC Waghodia, and has had past instances of delayed or incorrect filings with the RoC. Penalties could disrupt operations. [^drhp-p18] [^drhp-p19]

4. Intense competition: The specialty chemicals industry is highly fragmented with SMEs holding 70-75% market share, and global players with deeper pockets pose pricing pressure. Any inability to compete could reduce margins. [^drhp-p27] [^drhp-p94]

5. Product liability and quality claims: The company is exposed to product liability claims in India and export markets (Nigeria, Saudi Arabia, Sri Lanka). Adverse outcomes could affect reputation and financials. [^drhp-p27]
